question: Summarize the Fern Docs May 22, 2025 release
ground_truth:
The 2025-05-22 release introduced the following changes:
- Improvements to 404 Pages: Themed 404 pages now use your theme colors, fonts, and buttons, with best-effort navigation state maintained on the page.

metadata.cited_context:
## Improvements to 404 Pages
We now have themed 404 pages for your docs, using your theme colors, fonts, and buttons. We also maintain the best-effort
navigation state on this page using the 404 page URL, so that users can easily navigate back to your docs.
